title: Diagnostics consume judgment proof context instead of recomputing semantic proofs
allowed_surfaces: judgment fields; proof-context render helpers; readmodel.Reader query methods
banned_surfaces: direct state lattice reads; ad hoc subtype/value projection in renderers; AST-based guard fixpoints; producer-local type evaluators
filter_prompt: Does this file perform semantic proof computation instead of rendering or adapting judgment/readmodel proof context? Answer YES only for production code that recomputes type/value/nilability/reachability proofs locally rather than consuming judgment evidence or readmodel.Reader.
deep_prompt: Report concrete symbols where diagnostics or renderers recompute proof domains. Classify each as: renderer-only text logic, acceptable readmodel adapter, or violation that should move behind judgment/readmodel. Include file paths and function names.

title: WIR remains neutral lowered IR instead of carrying frontend or semantic owner dependencies
allowed_surfaces: neutral instruction descriptors; local scalar ids; path operands; TypeRef handles under the accepted Stage 4 type identity design
banned_surfaces: compiler/ast; compiler/source; compiler/parse; analysis/symbol; analysis/lua; analysis/check; methods that materialize semantic values from descriptors
filter_prompt: Does this production WIR file currently import frontend AST/source packages, semantic symbol packages, lua/check layers, or contain helper methods that derive semantic values instead of carrying neutral descriptors? Answer YES only for current production code violations, not historical/stale findings.
deep_prompt: Report concrete current WIR boundary violations only. Ignore stale claims not present in the file. Include file path, symbol/function, and the exact owner boundary violated.

title: Readmodel projects solved facts instead of re-solving semantic properties
allowed_surfaces: body.Result accessors; readmodel presentation structs; judgment/readmodel API projection helpers; canonical type-domain predicates
banned_surfaces: local recursive type predicates; generic instantiation; subtype decision ownership; local CFG dominance/reachability solving; direct typevalue structural projection when a solved fact should exist
filter_prompt: Does this production readmodel file make semantic decisions that should belong to body.Result, the engine, the judgment pass, or the canonical type domain? Answer YES only for current production code that computes semantic proof/type/CFG facts instead of projecting solved facts.
deep_prompt: Report concrete current readmodel projection-boundary violations. Classify each as: acceptable projection adapter, canonical type predicate candidate, body.Result accessor candidate, or engine/judgment fact gap. Include file paths and function names.

title: WIR transferfacts own WIR-mode provenance instead of falling back to semantic sidecars
allowed_surfaces: WIR operands; WIR instruction metadata; explicit unknown when WIR cannot prove a fact; semantic sidecars only for non-WIR mode or independent enrichment not used as fallback ownership
banned_surfaces: using sourceprovenance ASTSource to fill missing WIR value sources; l.valueSource(fallback) in WIR mode; result semantic facts manufacturing WIR-owned call sites returns assignments or object entries; sidecar fallbacks when WIR instruction is missing
deterministic_probe: rg -n "valueSource\(fallback\)|valueSources\(fallback\)|fallback source|semantic fallback|fell back to semantic|result == nil|add.*SidecarsForWIR|callSiteAt\(|returnValueSources\(|objectLiteral\(fact\)" analysis/lua/transferfacts -g'*.go'
filter_prompt: Does this production transferfacts file let WIR-mode lowering use semantic sidecar provenance as a fallback owner when WIR data is missing or unsupported? Answer YES for concrete WIR-mode fallback paths that can manufacture source identity or fact ownership from AST/semantics instead of WIR or explicit unknown. Answer NO for non-WIR legacy paths and tests.
deep_prompt: Report concrete WIR-mode semantic fallback seams only. For each, include file path, function, the exact fallback expression or branch, and whether the correct fix is WIR descriptor support, explicit unknown, or deletion after WIR coverage.

title: Placement plan only projects already-solved facts instead of solving or evaluating type predicates
allowed_surfaces: Entry/Plan projection of body.Result and state.State snapshots; placement.Join merges; existing readmodel/HoistableLoad accessors
banned_surfaces: local type predicate evaluation; CFG/dataflow fixpoint iteration; transfer/solve package calls; deriving new facts not already present on body.Result or state.State
filter_prompt: Does this file compute a new type predicate, run dataflow/fixpoint solving, or otherwise derive a fact instead of projecting an already-solved body.Result/state.State snapshot into a Plan/Entry? Answer YES only for current production code violations, not historical/stale findings.
deep_prompt: Report concrete current placementplan violations only. Include file path, symbol/function, and the exact owner boundary violated (solving/type-predicate logic that belongs upstream in body or engine, not here).

title: check/service only composes and orchestrates checker sessions instead of implementing checker logic
allowed_surfaces: session/query orchestration; calling check/body, fixpoint/program, diagnostics, placementplan, manifest, judgment APIs; snapshot/session bookkeeping
banned_surfaces: direct engine/transfer or engine/solve calls; direct ir/wir or ir/cfg manipulation; local type predicate evaluation (typ.IsSubtype/TypeOf); reimplementing checker logic instead of calling the owning package
filter_prompt: Does this file implement checker logic (type predicate evaluation, dataflow/fixpoint solving, direct IR manipulation) instead of composing and orchestrating calls into the owning check/body, fixpoint, diagnostics, placementplan, or manifest packages? Answer YES only for current production code violations, not historical/stale findings.
deep_prompt: Report concrete current service violations only. Include file path, symbol/function, and the exact owner boundary violated (checker logic that belongs upstream, not composition/orchestration here).
